reader.requirement: At --std 85 a file-name described by an SD entry (a sort or merge file) must be refused in a SAME AREA clause (the format without RECORD, SORT or SORT-MERGE, written with or without the optional word AREA) and admitted in SAME RECORD AREA, SAME SORT AREA and SAME SORT-MERGE AREA.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Edition.Year < 2002 selects the 1985 report-file row (SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA unlimited for a report file); the SortMerge row this rule uses (file-area max 0) is not switched

reader.edition-search: grep of sameClause/SameClause/SORT_MERGE across src/**/*.cs (no VersionConformancePass, ConstructRegistry or ReservedWords consult for the clause); grammar CobolIO.g4#sameClause is edition-neutral: SAME (RECORD|SORT|SORT_MERGE)? AREA? FOR? fileName+
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: a sort or merge file in the file-area format is refused at 1985 and 2023 alike (only the report-file row of the occurrence table differs below 2002, which is SR5/XIII.2.4.3 SR2, not this rule)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise SAME AREA naming a sort file and two SAME RECORD AREA clauses; not exercised: SAME without the word AREA, a clause naming only sort files, and the admitted SORT / SORT-MERGE / RECORD forms at --std 85

probes.printed: error COBOL2738: SAME AREA: sort or merge file 'S1' is named in a file-area format clause, which its kind bars (ISO §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR6 ...)
probes.expected: refused: S1 is a sort file in SAME AREA (SR4)

probes.printed: error COBOL2738 for 'S1' (SAME FOR F1 S1)
probes.expected: refused: AREA is an optional word, the clause is still the SAME AREA format
admitted: SAME AREA of two FD files (§1985:VII.2.13)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR4  (2.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR4
OK  §1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1  (2.13.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: The occurrence table gives a sort-merge file a file-area limit of 0 at every edition, and the 1985 arm only changes the report-file row. The rule is enforced at --std 85 in every spelling; the diagnostic text cites §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR6 rather than the 1985 rule, which is a wording point and not a conformance failure.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR1-SR6 and FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs#BindIoControl/#SameOccurrenceRule/#ScreenSameClauses: the SortMerge row (file-area max 0) is not edition-switched.
